quotes.title: HD 43197
quotes.card: HD 43197 is a star with an exoplanetary companion in the southern constellation of Canis Major.
quotes.introduction: It has been given the proper name Amadioha, as selected by Nigeria during the NameExoWorlds campaign that celebrated the 100th anniversary of the IAU.
